questions.q: According to this lesson's test, what determines whether a decision is 'infrastructure' or 'algorithms'?
options: Whether it involves Kubernetes at all
Whether changing it would change the model's final numerical weights, given the same hardware
Whether it involves a GPU
Whether Solara AI's platform team or research team made the decision
questions.explain: The test is: if changing the decision changes the model's final weights, it's an algorithm decision. If it only changes speed or reliability without changing the output, it's infrastructure.

questions.q: Which of these is an infrastructure-side concern, as defined in this lesson?
options: Choosing AdamW as the optimizer with specific beta values
Deciding the data mixture's fraction of code versus web text
Whether the data loaders can pull sharded data fast enough to keep GPUs from stalling
Choosing the model's number of attention heads
questions.explain: Data loading throughput is a speed/reliability concern that doesn't change the model's final weights — it's infrastructure. Optimizer choice, data mixture, and model architecture are all algorithm decisions.

questions.q: Why does the lesson say FSDP sits on 'both sides' of the infrastructure/algorithms line?
options: Because FSDP is deprecated and being replaced
Because choosing to use FSDP and how to shard is an algorithms decision, but making its collectives run fast on real hardware is infrastructure
Because FSDP only works with Ethernet, not InfiniBand
Because FSDP automatically decides the learning rate schedule
questions.explain: Deciding to use FSDP and selecting its sharding strategy changes memory use and communication patterns (algorithms). But ensuring the resulting AllGather/ReduceScatter traffic actually moves fast across the cluster is infrastructure.

questions.q: Which course, as described in this lesson, covers decisions like the optimizer, learning rate schedule, and data mixture?
options: Distributed Training Infrastructure (this course)
Kubernetes Orchestration
GPU Computing
Advanced LLM Training & ML Systems
questions.explain: Advanced LLM Training & ML Systems is named as the companion course that covers the algorithm-side decisions: sharding strategy choice, optimizer, learning rate schedule, and data mixture.

questions.q: A decision is made to switch solara-train's inter-node fabric from InfiniBand to a hypothetical faster network, with no other changes. Would this be an infrastructure or algorithm decision, per this lesson's test?
options: Algorithm decision, because it affects training
Infrastructure decision, because the model's final weights would be unchanged — only speed would change
Neither — it's a hardware decision outside the model entirely
Algorithm decision, because faster networks change the math of AllReduce
questions.explain: Swapping the network fabric changes how fast data moves but not the numerical result of training — the model is mathematically indifferent to it. That makes it an infrastructure decision by the lesson's test.
